_geometry: Viewing directions are NOT here. They are measured ommatidial directions in the generated configs/sense/retina_columns.json, written by python/sense/retina_map.py from the male-cns / Zhao micro-CT eye map, and spliced in by js/sense/loadConfig.js. Ray order must match the order the connectome's lamina nodes are routed to, so do not reorder or hand-edit them. This file holds only the photoreceptor response parameters below.
_polarity: Photoreceptors depolarise to light and are histaminergic, so light inhibits the lamina and L1/L2/L3 depolarise to a contrast decrement. That inversion is applied on the Python side via the sensory polarity carried by the derived graph; luminance here is plain brightness, 0 dark to 1 bright.
